display.purpose: Oversized close-set Synapse lettering; 23vw on mobile.

headline.purpose: Medium-weight narrative statements beside large demonstrations.

body.purpose: Short explanations; evidence pages retain readable line lengths.

navigation.purpose: Small links supporting the artifact rather than competing with it.

shadows.name: readout
shadows.purpose: Ground the metallic ordinary-bit analogy spheres.

shadows.name: history-plane
shadows.purpose: Separate saved detector time-boundary planes on ink.

motion.name: action-transition
motion.purpose: Cobalt hover and translateY(-2px) for primary actions.

motion.name: route-curtain
motion.purpose: Original cobalt internal-route wipe; router push follows after 260ms; reduced effects bypass it.

motion.name: loader-exit
motion.purpose: Reveal after fonts and first frame, with bounded recovery.

motion.name: wheel-inertia
motion.value: Lenis lerp: 0.085; autoRaf: true; smoothWheel: true; anchors: true
motion.purpose: Smooth wheel travel while preserving native touch, scrollbar, keyboard and anchors; bypassed for reduced motion/effects.

motion.name: sculpture-response
motion.value: Pointer interpolation: 0.045; draw threshold: 0.002; pixel ratio cap: 1.5
motion.purpose: Original GPU shader reacts to pointer and scroll, rests at idle and pauses draws when hidden/offscreen; a frame callback continues checking. Reduced effects show a still sculpture; SVG fallback handles WebGL failure.

motion.name: scroll-linked-scenes
motion.value: CSS view timelines under @supports and prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference
motion.purpose: Question/orbit reveal and sticky history assembly progressively enhance the readable scenes.

narrative.overview:
Synapse uses an original silver, ink, cobalt and acid identity: oversized close-set lettering, large geometric demonstrations and full-viewport scenes. The homepage leads with an immersive experience, then opens into readable evidence and methods. The interface recedes around the research and its author, Assirem Benseddik.

The owner explicitly replaced the previous paper/green editorial identity. Lusion and Unseen are references for ambition, not sources of copied code or assets. The sculpture is original procedural artwork; research graphics remain grounded in saved simulation artifacts.
keyCharacteristics: Oversized typography, irregular alignment and generous scene spacing.
Flat color fields with selective geometric and particle depth.
Pointer and scroll response with native touch and reduced-effects alternatives.
Explicit separation between visual metaphor, teaching analogy and measured evidence.
dos: Do preserve the original silver/ink/cobalt/acid world and self-hosted Manrope.
Do keep demonstrations large, interactive and connected to the research question.
Do distinguish sculpture metaphor, ordinary-bit analogy and saved experimental evidence.
Do retain native navigation, touch scrolling, reduced effects, readable methods and exact research limitations.
donts: Don't restore the rejected paper/green editorial identity.
Don't copy reference-site assets, shaders or code.
Don't turn research scenes into decorative dashboards or equal feature cards.
Don't imply quantum hardware, invented affiliations or results beyond the saved small simulation.
